description: Can this wallet move USDC? Live check of the issuers' own on-chain blacklists: Circle USDC (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche), EURC (Base, Ethereum) and Tether USDT (Ethereum), plus OFAC SDN exact match. Up to 20 EVM addresses per call. Returns PASS/BLOCK, which token+chain is frozen, block numbers and contracts read. Fails closed: if a chain cannot be read, 502 (not charged). Errors: 400 invalid address. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/wallet/stablecoin-blacklist.

address.description: one EVM 0x address, or up to 20 comma-separated

name: stablecoin_blacklist_check
title: Stablecoin freeze check (Circle USDC/EURC, Tether USDT) + OFAC
